senses.gloss: m. (part. pass. of a verb בעץ, denom. of בעצא) tinned, wrapt in tin-foil.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 32:11">Targ. Jer. XXXII, 11</cite> (a. 14, in some ed.) <he>כתיב ב׳ וחתים</he> written, wrapt in tinfoil and tied up (v. <he>חתם</he>) with a seal, opp. to <he>שטרא פתיחא</he>.
